model_choice: Maximum Covering Location Problem (MCLP) formulation. Decision variables: x_i (site selection) and y_j (coverage indicator). The objective is to maximize the population covered by at least one selected site. The binary nature of y_j (capped at 1) creates the non-separable interaction: once a block is covered by one site, additional sites covering the same block provide no additional benefit. For a realistic instance (100 sites, 2000 blocks), total variables ~2100, which fits the CGA GPU annealer limit of 3600.

blocks.meaning: City blocks not currently covered by existing playgrounds

k.meaning: Number of new playgrounds to establish

coverage.meaning: Binary indicator if site i covers block j
